QuestInfo.name: Food-Hunting for Moppie
QuestInfo.0: Moppie's master Huckle had completely forgotten about his trusty dog as he was conducting his studies in Orbis Tower. He felt so horrible that he wanted to at least feed Moppie with something...
QuestInfo.1: Huckle wants you to get some fishes for Moppie. Head down to the bottom of Orbis Tower and collect 50 fishes from Jr. Pepes.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered 50 of Jr. Pepe's Fishes for Huckle. These are Moppie's favorites!

0.0: Oh no, I have totally forgotten about Moppie. Poor thing is still waiting for me at the same spot. I better do something about it.
0.1: I would like to send him some of the food that he loves, but as you can see, I'm all tied up at work now. I can't even take a break. Can you get Moppie some food? Please? #b50 of Jr. Pepe's fish#k should do.

yes.0: Thank you! I may even put your name in one of the studies I have conducted over the years. Moppie loves the fishes that the Jr. Pepe's drop at the bottom of Orbis Tower. Please get him a bunch of those! Thanks!
yes.1: Once you gather the fish, please give them to Moppie! And make sure to tell him that I sent the fish for him. He'll be ecstatic! The next time you stop by the Orbis Tower, please feel free to drop by... I'll be here waiting. \n\n#i4000088# #t4000088# #b50#k

no.0: I have no spare time these days. Can you please help me, for Moppie's sake?

1.0: Did you get some fishes for my Moppie?

yes.0: Oh, these will make my Moppie so happy! Come see me again the next time you're in Orbis Tower.
yes.1: Aroooooooo! My master never forgot about me! Thank you so much for bringing good news to my life. Bark bark! I think you're one compassionate person ...

item.0: Where are they? I need #b50 of Jr. Pepe's Fishes#k.\r\nI can't disappoint my Moppie again...
